evidence: p109 为整页格鲁德族女性角色设定原画（画面手写日文标注如「ゲルド」「トライブ」），无正文；p201（印刷页232-233）为海拉鲁城堡镇概念图拼版，旁附小字说明「Hyrle Castle Town / This is how Hyrule Castle Town looked before the Great Calamity struck.」，以图为主；p311（印刷页362-363）为跨页大事年表《The History of Hyrule & The Historical Chronology of Each Race》，表格内含「Ganondorf becomes Ganon and invades Hyrule.」「The royal family of Hyrule feels threatened by the Sheikah's advanced technology」等多段英文正文。三页仅 1 页正文，其余为图版，判混合。
